# verify the closed form equals the enumeration for small n
import itertools, random
from fractions import Fraction
rng=random.Random(0)
for n in range(1,9):
    vecs=[(Fraction(rng.randint(0,9),10),Fraction(rng.randint(0,9),10),Fraction(rng.randint(0,9),10)) for _ in range(n)]
    tot=Fraction(0)
    for ts in itertools.product(range(3), repeat=n):
        w=Fraction(1)
        for t,v in zip(ts,vecs): w*=v[t]
        okA=True; seen=False
        for t in ts:
            if t==0:
                if seen: okA=False;break
            elif t==2: seen=True
            else: okA=False;break
        okB=any(all(t==0 for t in ts[:k]) and ts[k]==1 and all(t==2 for t in ts[k+1:]) for k in range(n))
        if okA or okB: tot+=w
    pre=[Fraction(1)]*(n+1); suf=[Fraction(1)]*(n+1)
    for i in range(n): pre[i+1]=pre[i]*vecs[i][0]
    for i in range(n-1,-1,-1): suf[i]=suf[i+1]*vecs[i][2]
    alt=sum(pre[k]*suf[k] for k in range(n+1))+sum(pre[k]*vecs[k][1]*suf[k+1] for k in range(n))
    assert tot==alt, (n, tot, alt)
    # also compare against main.full_score
    import importlib.util
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("main", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
    main = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(main)
    f=main.full_score([(float(a),float(b),float(c)) for a,b,c in vecs])
    assert abs(f-float(tot))<1e-12, (n, f, float(tot))
print("full_score closed form + enumeration agree for n=1..8")
